name: 61614 · Peoria, IL
findings: ZIP 61614 (Peoria) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61614 (Peoria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61614 (Peoria) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
